frames.name: pad
frames.prompt: Wide photograph of a rocket on a coastal launch pad at dawn. A tall slender white two-stage rocket with thin black bands stands beside a red steel lattice service tower, surrounded by four tall thin lightning masts. Wisps of white vapour vent from the rocket in the cool blue morning light, the first warm glow of sunrise on the horizon, flat marshland and low hangars around the pad, the ocean in the distance. Photoreal, documentary photography, crisp detail, natural colour, shot on a full-frame camera with a 30mm lens.

frames.name: rise
frames.prompt: Photograph looking up at a slender white two-stage rocket with a plain smooth white cylindrical body, two thin black bands, a clean plain white pointed nose cone with no windows, no dots and no markings, and four small dark trapezoid fins at the base, no wings, no delta fins, climbing on a brilliant pillar of orange and white flame in bright early-morning light. Clear deep blue sky above, a warm golden glow low on the horizon, the low sun lighting the white rocket body from the side, a long bright exhaust plume trailing down toward a billowing white smoke cloud far below. Daylight, not dusk, not night. Photoreal, IMAX documentary look, crisp clean detail.

frames.name: clouds
frames.prompt: Photograph of a slender white two-stage rocket with a plain smooth white cylindrical body, two thin black bands, a clean plain white pointed nose cone with no windows, no dots and no markings, and four small dark trapezoid fins at the base, no wings, no delta fins, rising straight up out of the top of a thick cumulus cloud deck on a single clean bright orange exhaust flame directly beneath its engines, the clouds parted smoothly around the flame, brilliant low sunlight above a sea of soft white clouds, the sky darkening to deep blue overhead. Nothing else in the sky, no debris. Photoreal, IMAX documentary look, crisp clean detail.

frames.name: stagesep
frames.prompt: Photograph high above Earth: the upper part of a slender white two-stage rocket with a plain smooth white cylindrical body, two thin black bands, a clean plain white pointed nose cone with no windows, no dots and no markings, and four small dark trapezoid fins at the base, no wings, no delta fins, brightly sunlit, climbing against the black of space, and just below it the spent white first stage with its four small dark fins separating cleanly and falling away. Far below, the curved blue limb of Earth with swirling white clouds and a thin glowing blue atmosphere line. Harsh direct sunlight, deep black space, no stars, photoreal, NASA footage look, crisp clean detail.

frames.name: fairing
frames.prompt: Photograph in low Earth orbit: the white upper stage of a slender white rocket with thin black bands, against the black of space. Its plain white pointed nose fairing has split into two smooth white halves hinging open and drifting apart, revealing a satellite wrapped in gold foil inside. Far below, the curved blue limb of Earth with swirling white clouds and a thin glowing atmosphere line. Harsh direct sunlight, deep black space, no stars, photoreal, NASA footage look, crisp detail.

frames.name: satellite
frames.prompt: Photograph of a single communications satellite in orbit above Earth. A compact box-shaped body wrapped in crinkled gold foil with a small white antenna dish on top, and exactly two long rectangular dark-blue solar panel wings extending straight out to the left and to the right in one line, like a horizontal bar through the body, glinting in the sunlight. Below it the spent white cylindrical rocket upper stage, and one curved white fairing half drifting away on the right. Behind, the curved blue Earth with swirling white clouds and a thin glowing atmosphere line. Deep black space, no stars, harsh sunlight, photoreal, NASA footage look, crisp detail.
